text:
The 2021 tree-cover loss is **supported and corroborated** under the assessment method. The current assessment supersedes the earlier status of pending corroboration.

Hansen/UMD mapped approximately **81.3 ha** of loss, or **2.23%** of the property. A later year was observed, and the JRC 2020 forest reference agrees with 98% of the loss area.

Of the mapped loss, 68.1 ha was in planted forest and 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest. A further 37.3 ha of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 ha and was not counted as an event.

The evidence does not establish the cause, deforestation or land-use change, legality, responsibility, or regulatory compliance.
